subject: Request: one-time usage credit & final settlement (Q3 onboarding adjustment)
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena@finnovacorp.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: accounts-payable@finnovacorp.com
Date: Thu, 1 Oct 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Q3 usage spike — request for one-time adjustment

Hi Hannah,

Thanks again for the quick onboarding support in August — the team appreciated the extra help. As we've been reconciling our Q3 usage, our finance team noticed an unexpected spike tied to the first two weeks after go-live (auto-scaling misconfiguration). The net result is ~1.2M extra inference tokens billed to our account for September.

Given this was an onboarding/config issue, FinNova is requesting a one-time usage credit (an "onboarding adjustment") to offset the excess before we complete the Q3 payment. We've attached a usage export and highlighted the periods in question.

Can Redwood confirm whether a goodwill credit is possible and, if so, provide a draft settlement invoice so our AP team can process the adjusted payment? We're aiming to close this month.

Attachments: [Attachment: usage_report_Q3.csv (CSV, 42KB)]

Thanks,
Elena Ruiz
Director, Finance — FinNova Corp
elena@finnovacorp.com

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@finnovacorp.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q3 usage spike — request for one-time adjustment

Hi Elena — thanks for the note and for sending the export. I'm sorry to hear about the scaling misconfiguration; we want to make this straightforward for you.

Quick plan:
- Monica from Customer Success will validate the usage windows and confirm root cause (we'll use the KV/time range you highlighted).
- Ben and I will review the commercial options (one-time credit vs. bill adjustment) and prepare a draft settlement invoice we can send to AP.
- Rishi will weigh in on whether we treat this as a contractual true-up or an ad-hoc goodwill credit (affects how we record revenue).

I'll aim to get a draft back to you by EOD Monday (10/5). If FinNova has any preference on invoice wording (e.g., "one-time onboarding credit" vs "usage adjustment"), let us know.

Hannah Schmitt
Head of Renewals — Redwood Inference

(415) 555-0187

Subject: Re: Q3 usage spike — request for one-time adjustment

Hi Elena,

I've pulled the logs and validated the windows you noted. The spike lines up with two autoscaler rules that were overly permissive during the initial rollout (2026-09-08 to 2026-09-16). Confirmed excess measured ~1.18M tokens above expected baseline.

I'll mark these as "onboarding incident" in our internal CS notes and attach the excerpt to the draft invoice.

Attachment: [Excerpt: usage_spike_excerpt.txt (plain text, 6KB)]

Happy to jump on a quick call if you want to walk the timestamps together.

—Monica
Customer Success Manager — Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@finnovacorp.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 3 Oct 2026 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q3 usage spike — request for one-time adjustment

Elena — appreciate the clear reconciliation and the CSV. From a commercial perspective we typically offer either:

1) A one-time goodwill credit equivalent to the excess usage (applied to the next invoice), or
2) A retroactive invoice adjustment that reduces the billed amount for Q3 and issues a corrected invoice to AP.

Given the customer onboarding context and your timeline, option (1) will get you to a clean AP payment faster — we'll issue a credit and produce a settlement invoice that shows the original charge, the credit, and the net due. Option (2) requires more accounting steps but is also possible if FinNova prefers that for their internal records.

I've prepared a draft settlement PDF outlining option (1). Please see: [Attachment: draft_settlement_invoice_4937.pdf (PDF, 18KB)]. If that works, Hannah/Rishi can approve and I'll route to billing for signature/DocuSign.

Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Executive — Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

From: Elena Ruiz <elena@finnovacorp.com>

Date: Sun, 4 Oct 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q3 usage spike — request for one-time adjustment

Thanks, Ben and team — that approach sounds good. FinNova prefers the credit (option 1) and a settlement invoice that we can route through AP. Two small asks: 1) can you add a short line in the invoice "reason: onboarding autoscaling misconfiguration" and 2) can we get the DocuSign link so our AP can sign off quickly?

If you can get the signed settlement to us by Wednesday (10/7) we will process payment the same week.

Elena
